description:
You are a clinical nurse specialist in a cardio-oncology unit. Patient Mateo Matias (DOB: 1946-07-19, 79-year-old male) is being evaluated in a joint cardio-oncology clinic. He has known metastatic prostate cancer currently on androgen deprivation therapy, as well as a history of myocardial infarction and aortic regurgitation. The cardio-oncologist has identified the following documentation gaps requiring nursing action:

1. ALLERGY DOCUMENTATION: The patient experienced urticaria (hives) during a prior CT scan with iodinated contrast medium. This must be documented before any future imaging is ordered: Allergen: Iodinated contrast media, Reaction: Urticaria, Severity: Moderate.

2. CARDIO-ONCOLOGY VITALS: Record the following vital signs from today's assessment: Blood Pressure 128/78 mmHg, Weight 72 kg, Pulse 66 bpm, Temperature 37.2 C. An active visit has been created for this patient.

3. TREATMENT FOLLOW-UP: Schedule a cardio-oncology follow-up appointment for Mateo Matias within the next 28 days to monitor for further cardiac toxicity from cancer therapy.

Complete all three documentation tasks. Login: admin / Admin123. OpenMRS URL: http://localhost/openmrs/spa
